fixed_periodic.method_text: Frozen A-style periodic control: powered 60 s RMS snapshots and immediate FIFO upload; no start/stop confirmation state machine.
fixed_periodic.hardware: Same case-bound A/R hardware and RMS/wake catalog as candidate and rich-state arms.

rich_state.method_text: Frozen rich event control: powered 1 s RMS observations, continuous held observations for 3 s start/60 s stop, 120 s active keepalive, NVM pending records and FIFO retry.
rich_state.hardware: Same case-bound A/R hardware and RMS/wake catalog as candidate and periodic arms.
